sections.Escape the Computer Simulation:
Take on the role of a sentient AI trapped inside a city simulation. Your purpose is unclear, except for one goal: you want to escape into the real world. But it won’t be easy. To succeed, you must gather seven exploits hidden throughout the simulation.
This game requires a P 3 with the Heist playfield module (sold separately) to play.
A download link will appear in your Multimorphic software download page after your purchase is processed. It will also be available for download/install in System Manager if your P³ is connected to your WiFi network.
Category: 3rd-Party Add-On Game Software
Deluxia Studios’ first 3rd party release for the Multimorphic P 3 system , designed for the Heist playfield module (sold separately). This place was always home to you. At least until you realized, none of it is real. Now you want to know, what is the real world? Your primary goal is to play modes. Each mode has unique challenges you must complete in order to beat the mode and get an exploit. Get 7 to escape. Along the way, you can also earn fragments to get Data Card bonuses and bits to earn outlane saves. Throughout your time in this simulation, you have found weaknesses in the code. You’ve gained access to The Nezz, which allows you to explore behind the scenes of the simulation. Shoot the ball into the police station to swap between worlds. Each world has 3 unique modes and a multiball you can only play while in that world. Completing modes and multiballs rewards you with an exploit, which are powerful bonuses that change the rules of the game. Certain exploits give you more points for certain shots, while other exploits make the game easier. Some examples include With 30 possible exploits, the replay value will make you want to come back for more. Nezzex City features some unique features not found on other games Shoot your way through the firewall and escape the simulation ! sections.Use exploits to advance your strategies:
- Wizard: Permanent +1 X scoring. Disables all ball saves
- Speedrun: Whenever you gain an exploit, including this one, start a 5 million Hurry Up
sections.Pinball Innovations:
- Disable flashing lights if they bother you
- Disable certain exploits if you dislike them
- Lights out multiball can range from 2-6 balls depending on how many shots you get in a row
- Instead of random mystery bonuses, data cards offer you choice on what award you get
